text: A cyclist has mass 85 kg and rides a bicycle of mass 20 kg. The cyclist rides along a horizontal road
against a total resistance force of 40 N. Find the total work done by the cyclist in increasing his speed
from 5 m s to 10 m s while travelling a distance of 50 m. [3]
A constant resistance of magnitude 1350 N acts on a car of mass 1200 kg.
